overview: A mobile-first mechanical engineering toolkit with a universal unit converter, five quick calculators, a searchable material property database, and a saved calculation history with PDF export.
features: Convert values across force, torque, pressure, stress, length, temperature, flow rate and thermal conductivity in SI and imperial units
Run five quick calculators: beam deflection, shaft sizing, pressure vessel wall thickness, torque conversion and material stress
Search a reference of 50 common metals and plastics with yield strength, modulus of elasticity, density and thermal properties
Save calculation results and export them as a PDF report
Switch the whole app between SI and imperial units with one toggle
High-contrast, large-touch-target interface with a preliminary-design disclaimer
